name: Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
summary: Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG is a large, financially stable motor maker within Nordmark Gruppe (EUR 1.38 bn turnover, 4,800 staff, credit index 147 and flat). We are only 0.2 % of its turnover. It has sent a formal 6.5 % increase on part:350011 effective 2027-01-01, citing copper and electronics costs. Its key account manager can move only up to 2 %; anything above goes to a pricing committee that meets every two weeks.

situation.decision_maker: Key account manager up to 2 % price change; above 2 % the pricing committee (meets every two weeks)

negotiation_pattern: It opens high on annual renewals (asks of 3.5-4.7 %) and settles at about a third of the ask (1.2-1.4 %), i.e. inside the KAM's 2 % authority. In the 2024 round it accepted a -2.6 % cut against its own ask of -0.4/-1.2 %. Its mean ask is +2.35 % and its mean settlement 0.0 %. It concedes steadily rather than walking away. This year's 6.5 % ask is well above its usual opening, so expect a fallback towards about 2 % to avoid the committee.
wants: Price increase on part:350011 that clears the copper/electronics cost argument
Volume growth and new business (part:350012 and part:350013 are qualified but have 0 % quota)
Contract continuity beyond 2026-12-31 and planning security
Payment on time (we pay late on 62 % of invoices)
A settlement inside KAM authority (≤2 %) to avoid the committee loop
protects: unit_price above the 2 % KAM authority (list/committee policy)
unit_price on part:350011, which may already be thin margin (priced 7.1 % below estimated own no-margin cost, low-confidence estimate)

trades.give: volume_per_year: award part:350012 and/or part:350013 (qualified, 0 % quota) or a higher share of part:350010
trades.get: unit_price on part:350011 held at ≤1.5 %, ideally 0-1.2 %
trades.why: Group sales are measured on volume, and new parts are the cheapest currency we have for a price concession.

trades.give: contract_months: extend the framework by 24 months
trades.get: price fixed for 2027 at ≤2 %, with effective_date pushed to 2027-04-01
trades.why: Term security is a term-side move it can grant without the committee, and the delay cuts the cost in 2027.

trades.give: index_clause: a copper index on the material share (~34 % of cost), symmetric with a deadband
trades.get: base price increase limited to ≤1 % now
trades.why: It answers its stated copper argument transparently and protects us when copper falls.

trades.give: payment_days: commit to strict on-time payment at 30 days (fix our 62 % late share)
trades.get: ppm_commitment ≤200 and an OTD plan to the 95 % target
trades.why: This costs us nothing real and removes a legitimate grievance.

arguments.point: History: in each of the last two renewals the ask settled at 1.2-1.4 %. Keep this round within the KAM's 2 % authority so there is no committee delay.
There is a competitive alternative on the 4 kW motor. The sup:70520 plant cost estimate is 8 % below the current price, and a second source is qualified for each part, so share can move.
Delivery is below the contractual 95 % target: OTD was 90.4 % in Q3 and 82.7 % a year ago. ppm rose from 181 to 273. An increase is hard to justify while performance is below agreement.
We have grown our spend with them from EUR 2.68 M (FY2024) to EUR 3.21 M (FY2026) and are a loyal, growing account.
6.5 % is not substantiated. Ask for a cost breakdown showing the copper and electronics share and the index movement before any figure above 2 % is discussed.

avoid: Do not lead with should-cost on part:350011. The estimate puts our price 7.1 % below its own no-margin cost (confidence only 5 %), which would support its case.
Do not issue ultimatums or demand price cuts. We are 0.2 % of its turnover, and pressure just escalates to the committee.
Do not expect fast answers on anything above 2 %. Committee cycles are two weeks; plan the timeline before 2027-01-01.
Do not complain about payment terms; we are the ones paying late.
tone: Factual, structured and businesslike. Give a clear package the KAM can sign off within 2 %, with data requests rather than emotion.
red_flags: The termination notice deadline under ctr:4600070510#8.1 is about 2026-10-02 (90 days before 2026-12-31). After that the contract auto-extends 12 months, so decide immediately whether to serve protective notice.
The increase notice (dated 2026-09-14) appears valid under the 90-day clause, so the 2027 price change is formally on the table.
We hold 100 % quota on part:350011, which makes a short-term switch hard even with one alternate source.
Quotes show lead times of 41-43 days vs the 35-day contract, and OTD is below target, so watch delivery risk if relations sour.
ppm is creeping up (181 → 273) while the scorecard is still green.

evidence.claim: 6.5 % increase on part:350011 from EUR 348.32 to 370.96, effective 2027-01-01, citing copper/electronics
KAM authority up to 2 %; above that the pricing committee, meeting every two weeks
Part of Nordmark Gruppe, EUR 1.38 bn turnover, credit index 147 stable; we are 0.2 % of its turnover
part:350011 priced 7.1 % below its estimated own no-margin cost; part:350010 priced 8.0 % above the sup:70520 cost estimate
Framework runs to 2026-12-31 and auto-extends 12 months unless terminated with 90 days' notice; prices fixed per calendar year with 90-day change notice
Quoted for part:350012 (EUR 709.85) and part:350013 (EUR 1495.59), neither awarded, so this is volume we can offer
